title: Small models for your agents' everyday jobs | Superlinked
excerpt: Compare task-specific open models against leading APIs on measured results. Use SIE Serverless or run the models in your own cloud.
content_html:
Call our API, or run the same models in your own clusters

SIE Serverless

Task-specific models behind one API, with usage-based pricing.

  • No GPUs to run or keep busy
  • Usage pricing, no idle GPU bill
  • SOC 2 Type 2, US or EU data
  • Same SDK and model IDs in your cluster

SIE Local

The open-source server, free on your laptop or a GPU VM.

  • Apache-2.0, the engine behind both
  • NVIDIA GPU or Apple Silicon
  • Same SDK and model IDs as the API
  • Offline; data stays on your machine

Native Inference

Run SIE Cluster in your own cloud, with our engineers helping your team evaluate models and operate the deployment.

Learn how teams run small open models in production
